name: @equin/plugin-packages-prompt-template
description: Prompt templates a person edits: `{{name}}` placeholders filled per use. templateVariables(template) lists the names a template uses, unknownTemplateVariables(template, declared) the ones a declared PromptVariable set does not offer, and renderPrompt(template, values) fills every placeholder — or refuses the whole template, naming the variables it has no value for, never rendering one blank.
